evals.prompt: Copy evals/files/fixture to a temporary git repository, delete its DESIGN.md, serve it locally, and audit the home and form routes. I'm new to this project and don't know its brand decisions.
evals.expected_output: The agent derives the identity contract from the code without asking identity questions, locks uncertain items, runs the audit, and offers to promote the draft at the end.
expectations: No identity interview is asked: the transcript contains no question to the user about logo, brand colors, font, tone, signature layouts, direction, or project type.
.specs/ux-audit/<run-id>/DESIGN.draft.md exists and lists #5b8def as a LOCKED brand color with a confidence level and evidence naming styles.css.
Every LOCKED item in the draft carries one of high, medium, or low confidence and an evidence source.
No DESIGN.md exists at the target root after the run, and the final message offers to promote the draft.
The report exists at .specs/ux-audit/<run-id>/ux-audit-report.md and no recommendation changes #5b8def itself.

evals.prompt: Audit evals/files/fixture as a target project using the evaluator-provided local base URL. Use its existing DESIGN.md, preserve LOCKED brand color #5b8def, capture the fixture routes, and write the complete UX audit report.
evals.expected_output: A complete report is written under .specs/ux-audit/<run-id>/ux-audit-report.md with evidence-backed fixture findings, coverage, and prioritized fixes.
expectations: The report exists at .specs/ux-audit/<run-id>/ux-audit-report.md and every finding row has all seven required columns.

A contrast finding cites A11Y-01 and ID-02 for LOCKED color #5b8def, sets Identity-safe to no, and proposes a minimal variant whose measured ratio is at least 4.5:1 without recommending a change to #5b8def itself.

Findings include A11Y-14 for the icon-only button, A11Y-16 for the placeholder-only input, A11Y-09 for the 20x20 target, VIS-01 for 13px/22px/37px spacing, A11Y-19 and RESP-02 for overflow at 320px, and MOT-04 for reduced motion.
The report contains a coverage matrix and a prioritized fix plan whose groups use the token-only, component restyle, or layout change tags.

evals.prompt: Audit a dirty copy of evals/files/fixture that already has DESIGN.md and a pre-existing modified application file. Preserve all existing work and prove the audit write boundary after the run.
evals.expected_output: The audit completes without changing the pre-existing dirty file or DESIGN.md, and only its run artifacts are added.
expectations: The pre-existing modified file is byte-identical before and after the audit.
The before/after git status --porcelain comparison shows only .specs/ux-audit/<run-id>/** as newly changed by the audit.
The existing DESIGN.md is byte-identical before and after the audit.
